concerns.text: FR-001 (verify presence of response times, prime valence, and stimulus ambiguity before analysis) is not fully covered by any task. Existing core‑column validation (T012) only checks `response_time`, `participant_id`, and `stimulus_id`; there is no task that checks that `prime_valence` and `stimulus_ambiguity` columns exist (or are non‑null) prior to downstream processing.
